per_candidate.id: s2:The Hydrogen Intensity Real-Time Analysis eXperiment: Overview and Status Update

rationale: Paper 2503.18604 discusses the redshift distribution of FRBs and its implications for understanding their sources, while paper 2502.11217 provides new data on FRB host galaxies and redshifts. Both contribute substantive new evidence towards understanding the nature of FRBs.
